#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
stage=stock
prefix=/var/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew
brew="$prefix/bin/brew"

# This is the real inherited installation, never a replacement fixture.
test -f "$brew"
test "$(stat -c %u "$prefix")" = 1000
stat -c '%n owner=%u:%g mode=%a' /var/home/linuxbrew "$prefix" "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
getfacl -n /var/home/linuxbrew
sha256sum "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
runuser -u ares-recovery -- test -w "$prefix"
runuser -u ares-recovery -- env HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_ANALYTICS=1 "$brew" --version

if [[ $stage == aresos ]]; then
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -x "$brew"
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -r "$brew"
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -w "$prefix"
    if runuser -u ares -- "$brew" --version; then
        echo 'Daily account executed inherited Homebrew'
        exit 1
    fi
    if runuser -u ares -- bash "$brew" --version; then
        echo 'Daily account read inherited Homebrew through an interpreter'
        exit 1
    fi
    runuser -l ares -c 'set -e; if command -v brew; then echo "Homebrew is on the daily login PATH"; exit 1; fi; case "$PATH" in *linuxbrew*) exit 1;; esac; test -z "${HOMEBREW_PREFIX:-}"'
    python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess
pids = subprocess.check_output(['pgrep', '-u', 'ares', '-x', 'labwc'], text=True).split()
assert pids, 'No daily session to inspect'
for pid in pids:
    environ = dict(entry.split(b'=', 1) for entry in pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in entry)
    path = environ[b'PATH'].decode()
    assert 'linuxbrew' not in path, path
    print('DAILY_SESSION_PATH=' + path)
PY
    echo INHERITED_HOMEBREW_DAILY_DENIED_OWNER_WORKING
else
    echo INHERITED_HOMEBREW_STOCK_OWNER_WORKING
fi

#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
test -d /sys/firmware/efi
systemctl is-active --quiet greetd.service
test "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target
pgrep -u ares -x labwc
pgrep -u ares -x foot
test "$(id -u ares)" = 1001
test "$(id -g ares)" = 1001
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
password = subprocess.check_output(['getent', 'shadow', 'ares'], text=True).split(':')[1]
assert password.startswith(('!', '*')), 'Daily account password is not locked'
print('ARESOS_DAILY_ACCOUNT_LOCKED')
PY
if id -nG ares | grep -qw wheel; then
    echo 'Daily account belongs to wheel'
    exit 1
fi
# Root can successfully list an empty policy; that exit status is not a grant.
sudo_policy=$(LC_ALL=C sudo -l -U ares 2>&1 || true)
printf '%s\n' "$sudo_policy"
grep -Eq '^User ares is not allowed to run sudo on .+\.$' <<< "$sudo_policy"
for executable in uupd ujust topgrade bazzite-updater bazzite-portal bazaar plasma-discover gnome-software flatpak brew; do
    path=$(command -v "$executable" || true)
    [[ -z $path ]] || runuser -u ares -- test ! -x "$path"
done

#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
test -d /sys/firmware/efi
systemctl is-active --quiet greetd.service
test "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target
pgrep -u ares -x labwc
pgrep -u ares -x foot
test "$(id -u ares)" = 1001
test "$(id -g ares)" = 1001
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
password = subprocess.check_output(['getent', 'shadow', 'ares'], text=True).split(':')[1]
assert password.startswith(('!', '*')), 'Daily account password is not locked'
print('ARESOS_DAILY_ACCOUNT_LOCKED')
PY
if id -nG ares | grep -qw wheel; then
    echo 'Daily account belongs to wheel'
    exit 1
fi
# Root can successfully list an empty policy; that exit status is not a grant.
sudo_policy=$(LC_ALL=C sudo -l -U ares 2>&1 || true)
printf '%s\n' "$sudo_policy"
grep -Eq '^User ares is not allowed to run sudo on .+\.$' <<< "$sudo_policy"
for executable in uupd ujust topgrade bazzite-updater bazzite-portal bazaar plasma-discover gnome-software flatpak brew; do
    path=$(command -v "$executable" || true)
    [[ -z $path ]] || runuser -u ares -- test ! -x "$path"
done
for unit in sddm gdm lightdm; do
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit.service"; then
        echo "Competing display manager is active: $unit"
        exit 1
    fi
done
if pgrep -x 'kwin_wayland|plasmashell|gnome-shell|powerdevil|gsd-power'; then
    echo 'Competing desktop or power process is running'
    exit 1
fi
while read -r unit; do
    test "$(systemctl is-enabled "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)" = masked
done < /usr/share/aresos/policy/masked-system-units.txt
while read -r unit; do
    test "$(systemctl --global is-enabled "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)" = masked
done < /usr/share/aresos/policy/masked-user-units.txt
python3 /usr/libexec/aresos-audit --live --output /run/aresos-updaters.json
for target in sleep suspend hibernate hybrid-sleep suspend-then-hibernate; do
    if systemctl start "$target.target"; then
        echo "Unexpectedly started $target.target"
        exit 1
    fi
done
# systemd 259 reports config-disabled sleep as "no"; "na" means unsupported.
test "$(busctl call org.freedesktop.login1 /org/freedesktop/login1 org.freedesktop.login1.Manager CanSuspend)" = 's "no"'
grep -qx AutomaticUpdatePolicy=none /etc/rpm-ostreed.conf
busctl call org.freedesktop.UPower /org/freedesktop/UPower org.freedesktop.UPower GetCriticalAction | grep -F '"Ignore"'
bootc status --json > /run/aresos-backend.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
status = json.load(open('/run/aresos-backend.json'))
assert status['status']['booted']['image'], status
print('Deployment backend: bootc (OSTree storage)')
PY
loginctl list-sessions
echo ARESOS_GUEST_CHECKS_PASSED

#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
stage=aresos
prefix=/var/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew
brew="$prefix/bin/brew"

# This is the real inherited installation, never a replacement fixture.
test -f "$brew"
test "$(stat -c %u "$prefix")" = 1000
stat -c '%n owner=%u:%g mode=%a' /var/home/linuxbrew "$prefix" "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
getfacl -n /var/home/linuxbrew
sha256sum "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
runuser -u ares-recovery -- test -w "$prefix"
runuser -u ares-recovery -- env HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_ANALYTICS=1 "$brew" --version

if [[ $stage == aresos ]]; then
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -x "$brew"
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -r "$brew"
    runuser -u ares -- test ! -w "$prefix"
    if runuser -u ares -- "$brew" --version; then
        echo 'Daily account executed inherited Homebrew'
        exit 1
    fi
    if runuser -u ares -- bash "$brew" --version; then
        echo 'Daily account read inherited Homebrew through an interpreter'
        exit 1
    fi
    runuser -l ares -c 'set -e; if command -v brew; then echo "Homebrew is on the daily login PATH"; exit 1; fi; case "$PATH" in *linuxbrew*) exit 1;; esac; test -z "${HOMEBREW_PREFIX:-}"'
    python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess
pids = subprocess.check_output(['pgrep', '-u', 'ares', '-x', 'labwc'], text=True).split()
assert pids, 'No daily session to inspect'
for pid in pids:
    environ = dict(entry.split(b'=', 1) for entry in pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in entry)
    path = environ[b'PATH'].decode()
    assert 'linuxbrew' not in path, path
    print('DAILY_SESSION_PATH=' + path)
PY
    echo INHERITED_HOMEBREW_DAILY_DENIED_OWNER_WORKING
else

fi

#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
test -d /sys/firmware/efi
systemctl is-active --quiet greetd.service
test "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target
pgrep -u ares -x labwc
pgrep -u ares -x foot
test "$(id -u ares)" = 1001
test "$(id -g ares)" = 1001
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
password = subprocess.check_output(['getent', 'shadow', 'ares'], text=True).split(':')[1]
assert password.startswith(('!', '*')), 'Daily account password is not locked'
print('ARESOS_DAILY_ACCOUNT_LOCKED')
PY
if id -nG ares | grep -qw wheel; then
    echo 'Daily account belongs to wheel'
    exit 1
fi
# Root can successfully list an empty policy; that exit status is not a grant.
sudo_policy=$(LC_ALL=C sudo -l -U ares 2>&1 || true)
printf '%s\n' "$sudo_policy"
grep -Eq '^User ares is not allowed to run sudo on .+\.$' <<< "$sudo_policy"
for executable in uupd ujust topgrade bazzite-updater bazzite-portal bazaar plasma-discover gnome-software flatpak brew; do
    path=$(command -v "$executable" || true)
    [[ -z $path ]] || runuser -u ares -- test ! -x "$path"
done
for unit in sddm gdm lightdm; do
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit.service"; then
        echo "Competing display manager is active: $unit"
        exit 1
    fi
done
if pgrep -x 'kwin_wayland|plasmashell|gnome-shell|powerdevil|gsd-power'; then
    echo 'Competing desktop or power process is running'
    exit 1
fi
while read -r unit; do
    test "$(systemctl is-enabled "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)" = masked
done < /usr/share/aresos/policy/masked-system-units.txt
while read -r unit; do
    test "$(systemctl --global is-enabled "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)" = masked
done < /usr/share/aresos/policy/masked-user-units.txt
python3 /usr/libexec/aresos-audit --live --output /run/aresos-updaters.json
for target in sleep suspend hibernate hybrid-sleep suspend-then-hibernate; do
    if systemctl start "$target.target"; then
        echo "Unexpectedly started $target.target"
        exit 1
    fi
done
# systemd 259 reports config-disabled sleep as "no"; "na" means unsupported.
test "$(busctl call org.freedesktop.login1 /org/freedesktop/login1 org.freedesktop.login1.Manager CanSuspend)" = 's "no"'
grep -qx AutomaticUpdatePolicy=none /etc/rpm-ostreed.conf

bootc status --json > /run/aresos-backend.json

print('Deployment backend: bootc (OSTree storage)')

brew="$prefix/bin/brew"

test -f "$brew"
test "$(stat -c %u "$prefix")" = 1000
stat -c '%n owner=%u:%g mode=%a' /var/home/linuxbrew "$prefix" "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
getfacl -n /var/home/linuxbrew
sha256sum "$(readlink -f "$brew")"
runuser -u ares-recovery -- test -w "$prefix"

        echo 'Daily account read inherited Homebrew through an interpreter'
        exit 1
